clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Spearman rank correlations between total extreme Jacobian deviation counts (|z|>2) and a general cognitive ability factor (first PC from seven UKB cognitive tests); additional exploratory correlations with behavioral variables and polygenic scores.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Pathogenic CNV carriers exhibit heterogeneous, individualized neuroanatomical deviation profiles; specific regions show pronounced deviations in highlighted CNVs (e.g., cerebellum/brainstem/pallidum in some 1q21.1dup; caudate/accumbens in some 1q21.1del); greater negative deviations associate with lower general cognitive ability.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Using normative models across IDPs and voxel-wise Jacobians, the study quantified individual deviation maps and extreme deviation counts. For 1q21.1 distal CNVs, some duplication carriers showed large negative deviations in cerebellum, brainstem, and pallidum, while some deletion carriers showed notable positive deviations in caudate and accumbens. Compared to the no-CNV cohort, CNV carriers’ extreme deviation counts often lay in the tails of the reference distributions. Across the cohort, total extreme negative deviations (z<-2) were modestly but significantly associated with lower general cognitive ability (Spearman r≈-0.04, P≈0.04), whereas extreme positive counts were not (r≈0.03, P≈0.09).

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Lack of longitudinal imaging for CNV carriers—especially younger ages; conclusions constrained to older UK Biobank age range; potential influence of non-CNV factors (environmental, genomic) on deviation scores.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: "One limitation of our study is the lack of longitudinal imaging data for the pathogenic CNV carriers, particularly within the younger age range ... our conclusions are constrained to participants within the older age range due to the limited availability of CNV data to only the UK Biobank. ... we acknowledge that ... the individual deviation scores might be partly driven by effects outside of the CNVs, for instance, the remaining genome ... environmental factors can lead to molecular 'scars' ..."

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Individual-level normative modeling enables per-subject deviation maps and risk profiles by counting extreme deviations (|z|>2) across modalities; demonstrated on UK Biobank CNV carriers with examples for 1q21.1 CNVs; approach supports personalized characterization rather than case–control averages.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Publication year is 2024 (file named Fraza2023). Demographics (age/sex) are summarized in supplementary tables as images; numeric values not extractable from provided text. IDP analysis used 44,456 UKB participants and 2,084 IDPs (FUNPACK v2.8). Voxel-wise Jacobian model pooled seven sites (Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS, PNC, UKB) with visual QC (N=19,620). Modeling used PCNtoolkit v0.28 with warped BLR, spline age effect, site fixed effects, and test-set evaluation (EV, MSLL, skew, kurtosis).
